setup_excluded: Assignment, inputs, template and contract reading
Cloud browser selection and documentation initialization
active_actions: One cloud browser tab creation and navigation
One browser observation/screenshot capture call including URL read and evidence preservation
count_definition: Top-level active tool invocations; nested browser operations are not counted individually. Capability load is one nested skills.read call inside functions.exec. The other two are mcp__cua_repl.js calls.
timing_limitation: Browser action interval was measured with Date; no timestamp was captured before the native skill-load call, so complete active and elapsed timing cannot be reconstructed precisely. No stopwatch enforcement was installed.
